items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Harvey Mason was on that... He’s on it. Alex Acuña, Harvey Mason, Milt Holland, Abraham Laboriel, Lee Ritenour.

ctx.x: You record a whole side of a record direct-to-disc. So you can’t stop. So that was the very first. I think Harvey Mason was on that.
He’s on it. Alex Acuña, Harvey Mason, Milt Holland, Abraham Laboriel, Lee Ritenour.
